name: Coffee run
description: Say what you're out of. Bean & Leaf, the demo shop at /shop, says what it has; NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super picks a cart within your budget; the shop prices it, and your board shows the shop, each line and the total. Nothing is bought until you hold the board's button to sign: then the shop charges the PayPal you linked there, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning says what was bought. Needs NEBIUS_API_KEY, a PayPal sandbox app for the shop (PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID and PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET), and a board in Devices.
example: We're out of coffee and filters. Keep it under $40.

assistants.name: Bean & Leaf
assistants.description: A coffee and tea shop that sells to agents, and charges only for carts your board signed.

assistants.name: Picker (Nemotron Super)
assistants.description: Picks what to buy from what a shop has.

assistants.name: Hud (Nemotron Lightning)
assistants.description: Says what happened, in a sentence.

steps.ask: In one short sentence, as you'd say it out loud, tell me what was bought, for how much, and that PayPal took it: {{pay.text}} What was in it: {{pay.data.items}}
